title: Description of sampling sites.
author: Michael Owusu
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Select sites and schedule sampling
steps.instruction: Choose 40 validated peri‑urban sites in Ghana and schedule monthly wastewater sampling beginning in July 2022 and continuing through August (end of study).

steps.title: Collect and maintain wastewater samples
steps.instruction: During the first six months, collect both grab samples and install Moore swabs at each site each month; after six months, continue only with monthly Moore‑swab placement and retrieval.

substeps.instruction: Collect a grab (GS) sample from each site.
Deploy a Moore swab (MS) in the wastewater flow at each site.
Retrieve the Moore swab after the monthly exposure period.

steps.title: Extract DNA and run multiplex qPCR
steps.instruction: Extract nucleic acid from each wastewater sample and perform multiplex quantitative PCR targeting Salmonella Typhi genes ttr, staG, tviB and the human fecal marker Bacteroides HF183.

substeps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction on the collected sample.
Prepare a multiplex qPCR reaction containing primers/probes for ttr, staG, tviB and HF183.
Run the qPCR assay under the appropriate cycling conditions and record Ct values.

steps.title: Conduct blood‑culture clinical surveillance
steps.instruction: Collect blood from febrile patients residing in the study area who present to the local hospital and process by standard blood‑culture methods for Salmonella Typhi.

substeps.instruction: Identify febrile cases living in the study catch‑area.
Draw an appropriate volume of blood and inoculate into blood‑culture bottles.
Incubate and monitor cultures according to standard laboratory protocols.
